column3: “Men” replaces sons of men; “God’s” specifies His; in the Spirit is rendered “by the Spirit.”
The genitive His faith is rendered “faith in Him”; “God’s presence” is supplied.
“You” supplies the unexpressed subject of not losing heart.
“I ask” is supplied; inner man is rendered “inner being.”
“Of the love of Christ” is supplied as a complement to the dimensions in verse 18.
The age of the ages is rendered “forever and ever.”
